get_callbacks: build a list of training callbacks including ConsoleLogger, BestStatsTracker, and VisionModelSaver for an EGG game
BestStatsTracker: create a BestStatsTracker callback to track best and last training and validation accuracy and loss per epoch
VisionModelSaver: create a VisionModelSaver callback to save vision module encoder state dicts to the trainer checkpoint directory
DistributedSamplerEpochSetter: create a DistributedSamplerEpochSetter callback to set the epoch on DistributedSampler for distributed training
review_get_callbacks: review the get_callbacks function to understand how it assembles callbacks conditionally based on distributed and temperature settings
